sources.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: These results position Kimi K2 as one of the most capable open-source large language models to date, particularly in software engineering and agentic tasks. We release our base and post-trained model checkpoints 1 to facilitate future research and applications of agentic intelligence.

sources.title: Kimi AI with K3 | Built for Agentic Coding & Knowledge Work
sources.snippet: Try Kimi K3 to build playable multiplayer and 3D games, create consulting grade slides, and run parallel tasks with Swarm and Goal to get more work done.

sources.title: K2 Agent Model Field Guide - kimi.ai
sources.snippet: Research Kimi K2 as an open-weight agent model using evidence available through June 30, 2026. Task module — Core field guide: explain K2 architecture, training, benchmarks, agent tool use, applications, license, access, pricing, and limitations.

sources.title: Kimi K2 - Open Agentic Intelligence | 1T MoE | Moonshot AI
sources.snippet: Kimi K2 by Moonshot AI - 1 trillion parameter open-source MoE model with 32B active parameters, 128K context, MuonClip optimizer, exceptional coding, reasoning, and agentic capabilities. Released July 2025 under Modified MIT License.

sources.title: Kimi K2: Open Agentic Intelligence
sources.snippet: Kimi K2 is our latest Mixture-of-Experts model with 32 billion activated parameters and 1 trillion total parameters. It achieves state-of-the-art performance in frontier knowledge, math, and coding among non-thinking models.
